verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents a public REST API at api.stripe.com/v1/identity/verification_sessions, with a curl example, that tracks verifications from creation to results. Secret-key programmatic access to results and webhook events for status changes are also documented. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths all returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This API tracks a verification, from initial creation through the entire verification process, and shows verification results upon completion.
You can access most verification details programmatically... using your secret key.
Stripe generates events every time a session changes status.
